nodes.label: Road signs include regulatory, warning and guide categories, distinguished by shapes and colors, and the written examination asks applicants to identify them.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning shape and color help identify sign category; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A red sign with eight sides requires a full stop at the line, otherwise before the crosswalk or, if neither exists, before the intersection, followed by yielding to pedestrians and approaching traffic.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning octagonal red stop requires full stop and yield; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Treat a temporary stop sign erected by highway authorities like a permanent stop sign.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning temporary stop sign still controls traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For a handheld stop sign, remain stopped until the authorized crossing guard or work-zone flagger indicates it is safe to go.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning handheld stop waits for authorized release; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The red-and-white three-sided yield sign requires letting vehicles and pedestrians proceed first.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning triangular yield gives priority; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A round yellow railway-warning sign uses a black crossed symbol and railway letters to warn that tracks cross the road ahead.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning round yellow sign warns of tracks ahead; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A rural railway advance-warning sign can stand as far as seven hundred fifty feet before the crossing; slow, look, listen through an open window and stop for an approaching train.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning advance rail sign is before the tracks; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A diamond warning sign can be yellow, yellow-green or orange with black text or symbols and calls for slower, careful driving near possible hazards.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning diamond shape warns of hazards; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign with black children symbols identifies a school zone or school crossing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning five sides signal school area; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A school sign depicting children with a downward arrow marks the crossing itself, while the children symbol without that arrow warns of a nearby school.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning downward arrow locates school crossing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A yellow, black-lettered three-sided no-passing sign stands on the left of a two-lane two-way road where the no-passing area begins.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning left-side pennant starts no-passing zone; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Square and rectangular shapes can serve either regulatory or guide purposes.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning rectangle alone does not define sign purpose; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Red regulatory signs such as stop, yield, wrong-way and do-not-enter signs must be obeyed.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning red commonly gives regulatory control; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Black-and-white signs can be regulatory controls or route markers.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning black and white has more than one use; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Yellow warning signs identify road conditions or dangers ahead.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning yellow warns of conditions ahead; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Yellow-green warnings can identify pedestrian and bicycle crossings, playgrounds, school-bus stops and school zones.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning yellow-green highlights people and school hazards; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Orange usually warns of construction or maintenance dangers along a road.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning orange warns of road work; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Green guide signs provide location, direction and distance information.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning green guides travel; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Blue guide signs identify services along the road.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning blue identifies roadside services; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Brown signs identify parks and recreation.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning brown identifies recreation; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Pink signs may warn of unplanned incidents such as crashes or natural disasters.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning pink can mark incident hazards; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A regulatory sign gives a direction that drivers must obey.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning regulatory instructions are mandatory; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: At an all-way stop, every approach stops and the first driver stopped proceeds first while the others wait their turns.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning all approaches stop, first stopped goes first; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Approaching a yield sign requires slowing to a safe speed and stopping when necessary before giving way to vehicles and pedestrians.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning yield may require full stop; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A do-not-enter sign forbids entering the indicated road or ramp, including a wrong-direction expressway entrance.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning do not enter the prohibited approach; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A speed-zone-ahead sign warns that a change of speed may soon be required.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning prepare for approaching speed zone; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Posted freeway limits can specify minimum and maximum speeds, and traveling below the minimum is unlawful unless safety requires it.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning minimum speed has safety exception; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning wrong way means wrong direction of travel; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A red circle crossed diagonally from upper left to lower right means the depicted action is forbidden.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning red diagonal circle prohibits depicted action; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning follow one-way arrow; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning center turn lane has signs and markings; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
